title: A1 II open gate, sensor side: 4320 x 2880 (3:2, 2x2 binned, full height) in modes 0x820/0x2820/0x8c0/0x28c0, first stage 4332 x 2896 squeezed into the stock 4320 x 2430 front end, vertical sampling ratio 27/32
status: built from the firmware files and emulated in parts; never run on a camera

ported_from.how: the A7 IV's mechanism (full-height window, Lrc squeeze, 27/32) rebuilt on the A1 II's own tables and records; the window is the sensor's own vertical window registers in the 4K sensor mode (the A7 IV switched modes)

stored_record_note: RAM, filled by the camera at start-up from the tables; records base = the drive-parameter object's +0x10 (emulation 0x24dba14) + index x 0x170; the write level finds each mode's record through the pointer chain
not_shown: that the sensor reads 2,880 binned rows in mode 0x14 with s = 1, n = 30 (the window rule holds in every stock column; no stock column is 2x2 at full height)
the margins a full-height 2x2 window gives (the stock 4K margins 8 / 8 + 2 trailing are kept; the full-res still mode has 12 physical rows each side)
+0x90 = 63 (33 + n holds in the three 0x14 columns)
the resize fit with 27/16 over 2/1 on this body (CalcRC / the RC calc were not emulated on the A1 II)
that the raw write buffer holds the 2,896-row stage (modding/A1M2_PORT_DMM_SIZE.md)
